patch_description: Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic, vectorized differential-evolution search over eight free points while fixing the three vertices of the containing equilateral triangle. Points are parameterized by barycentric coordinates, so every candidate is guaranteed to remain inside the triangle. The objective evaluates all 165 triples simultaneously and maximizes their minimum doubled area. A final deterministic local batch search refines the best evolutionary candidate. This avoids optional optimization dependencies, uses a fixed seed, and includes a finite fallback path because the initial population always supplies a valid arrangement.
